title: Topology
pageDesc: Live view of how Web Services traffic flows from the Internet through listeners and sites to backends, with status and active visitors
layoutTreeDesc: Five columns from left to right, with the most detail
layoutVerticalDesc: Top to bottom like an org chart; drag sideways to explore
layoutRadialDesc: Gately in the center with each level on a ring, more compact with many nodes
layoutSankeyDesc: Band widths follow QPS, so you see at a glance where traffic goes
layoutSunburstDesc: Concentric ring segments, darker means more traffic; suits many sites
layoutTreemapDesc: Listeners, sites and backends nested as blocks, darker meaning more traffic
layoutPackDesc: Nested circles that show at a glance how many sites each listener has
filterIssuesDesc: Listeners that failed to start, sites that are not running and unhealthy backends
filterPlaceholder: Type or pick an active IP
ipInactive: {ip} sent no requests in the last 60 seconds
maskTip: Choose what to mask so addresses stay hidden in shared screenshots; search still matches the full text
maskStarsDesc: Hides the last part of IPs and the middle of domains, keeping the network and the ends for a rough idea of location
maskAliasDesc: Replaces the whole value with a number that stays the same on this page (such as Visitor-01 or domain-02.com); no network or domain parts are kept, equal values get the same alias
maskVisitorDesc: Addresses in the active IP list and the filter
maskBackendDesc: IPs and host names in backends and redirect targets
maskListenerDesc: Listen IPs, error messages and sites that use an IP as domain
maskDomainDesc: Site domains and domains in site names
qpsHelp: Average requests per second over the last 10 seconds
qps60Help: Average requests per second over the last 60 seconds
bpsHelp: Average bytes per second sent to visitors over the last 10 seconds
bpsUpstreamHelp: Average response body bytes per second returned by the backend over the last 10 seconds (data after a WebSocket upgrade is not included)
activeHelp: Requests not finished yet, including long-lived ones such as WebSocket
requestsHelp: Requests since the listener started; kept when sites are edited, reset when listener settings such as the port change
errorsHelp: Forwarding failures such as an unreachable backend
blockedHelp: Requests refused by access control, by reason; failed sign-ins are not counted
connsHelp: Requests currently being forwarded to this backend
activeIpsHelp: Visitor addresses with requests in the last 60 seconds, plus addresses with requests still in flight; not a history
ipTruncated: Too many visitor addresses, only part of them are listed
ipNone: No visitors in the last 60 seconds
actionRedirectDesc: Plain HTTP requests on an HTTPS port, answered with 301 / 308
actionNotFoundDesc: No site matched and no default site is enabled, answered with 404
terminalCloseDesc: Closed without any response (logged as 444); this is the configured behavior, not a fault
paused: Paused while the page is in the background
note: All numbers come from this instance's in-memory counters and are not aggregated across instances. QPS and traffic are 10-second averages; active IPs are addresses with requests in the last 60 seconds.
zoomHint: Drag to pan, scroll to move; hold Ctrl/⌘ while scrolling, or pinch on a trackpad or touch screen, to zoom
heightHint: Drag to resize, double-click for automatic height
ipLogs: View this IP's access log on this site
ipLogsAll: View this IP's access log on all sites
